coverage.reason: Verify select-then-Apply and the persistent footer on desktop and landscape phones, all five Default City previews, purchase/apply/default ownership flows, public appearances and stage changes. Check visibility-based animation limits, motion preferences, overlay/background pauses, detached/recycled nodes and stable map reconciliation. Check production entry/cache references and shared responsive styling. Server authority and economy rules are unchanged; no backend emulator dependency changes.
Exercise the actual Default City art, explicit Apply, selection persistence through wallet updates, preview-only changes and touchable footer actions at four desktop/landscape sizes.

Validate the motion guards and bounded renderer against a 60-city fixture, then verify the real map and selected preview still show moving bats while collection thumbnails and the covered map stay still. Frame timings are reported, not used as hardware-dependent pass/fail thresholds.
The existing build gate checks the narrowly increased 56 KiB cosmetics module cap against 57,104 normalized bytes. No new art or dependencies; all other entry, shell and asset caps remain enforced.
Record the user-confirmed selection followed by Apply, including applying Default City; the browser regression verifies the documented behavior.
